svg.title: Spectral Contributions to Resistances in P6 and C6
svg.desc: P6: R16=(7+4√3)/3+1/3+(7−4√3)/3=5, R34=1/3+1/3+1/3=1. C6: R12=1/3+1/3+1/6=5/6; R13=1+1/3=4/3; R14=4/3+1/6=3/2. Segment heights represent the exact values; the panels use different scales.

cc:Work.dc:description: P6: R16=(7+4√3)/3+1/3+(7−4√3)/3=5, R34=1/3+1/3+1/3=1. C6: R12=1/3+1/3+1/6=5/6; R13=1+1/3=4/3; R14=4/3+1/6=3/2. Segment heights represent the exact values; the panels use different scales.
